title: A U.S. Open Match Ended at 3:30 a.m. It Wasn’t Over for the Workers.
summary: After the epic match between Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton was finally done, cashiers, ushers and cleaning crews got to work. Their next shift was only hours away.
